test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Find the value of given expression.

[76 – {90 ÷ 5 x (24 – 36 ÷ 3) ÷ 3}]
solution:
**Given:**

**[76 – {90 ÷ 5 × (24 – 36 ÷ 3) ÷ 3}]**

**Formula used:**

BODMAS Rule

**Calculation:**

[76 - {90 div 5 times (24 - 12) div 3}]

⇒ [76 - {18 times 12 div 3}]

⇒ [76 - 72]

⇒ 4

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
